svg.title: EH3D-PHOENIX-CAD architecture
svg.desc: EH3D-PHOENIX-CAD is early code for a parametric mechanical CAD focused on the design of enclosures, chassis and heat sinks. Today it has the base of every repository of the suite and a library with a parametric enclosure, a 2D sketch with a solver and the extrusions and pockets of its outlines; nothing has been run on a machine.
